newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Metrogas in 57 mln peso capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Metrogas in 57 mln peso capital increase.

text.p: Argentine gas distributor Metrogas said Wednesday it was would make a 56.6 million peso capital increase, issuing additional registered shares of common stock at one peso each.
"The increase will represent an increase of approximately 11.05 percent in the issued and outstanding share capital of the company," Metrogas said.
Metrogas is the largest of the eight gas distribution companies that commenced operations in 1992 upon the privatization of Gas del Estado.
British Gas Plc is the technical operator of Metrogas.
